## network

| Module | ID | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Backtrack | `backtrack` | Holds one target's movement packets, so you swing at where they were instead of where they are. |
| FakeLag | `fake-lag` | Delays your packets (outbound), the server's (inbound), or both, to fight on stale positions. |
| GlobalNetworkInterceptor | `network-optimizer` | Ensures outgoing packets are compliant with server-side checks by smoothing movements and snapping rotations. |
| LagRange | `lag-range` | Delays your packets only while closing on a target, flushing the moment the exchange changes. |
